children: William S. Moss III, an Officer serving as Executive Vice President and General Counsel, reported a sale of common stock on September 2, 2026. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $17.32 per share, with individual sale prices ranging from $17.27 to $17.35. The total sale amount reported was $2,078,400. Following the transaction, Moss directly beneficially owns 305,117 shares of common stock.
